# About Me
I am Population geneticist broadly interested in understanding genomic consquences of complex trait evoltion, and ultimate mechaisms facilitating complex trait evolution. Currently, I am a completing my PhD dissertation focused on investigating intragenomic conflict driven by the evolution of viviparous matrophic reproduction in the livebearing fish family Poeciliidae. I am also interested in computational, statistical and machine learning methods for analyzing large-scale genomic data and phenotypic data.
